text: およぎ　つかれて　ひとやすみ…　と　おもったら　しょうぶかい！

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: ひとやすみ…　と　おもったら
patterns.explanation: と before おもう shows what was thought, like quotation marks. ひとやすみ…　と　おもった = 'I thought, "a short rest..."'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら here means 'when I did this, that happened', with surprise at what came next. と　おもったら = 'just when I thought so'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a casual, mostly male form of the question か, here said in disbelief. しょうぶかい = 'a battle, is it?!'
